newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says expects rise in gold, silver production.
newsitem.headline: Manila says expects rise in gold, silver production.

text.p: Philippine gold production is expected to rise to 33,263 kg this year compared with 29,958 last year, a senior official of the Mines and Geosciences Bureau said on Wednesday.

Silver production this year is also expected to increase to 26,016 kg from the year-ago 24,027, Benjamin de Vera, the bureau's mineral economics and policy division chief, said in an interview with reporters.
De Vera said better extraction methods by local mining companies would help increase gold and silver production this year.
Gold panners contributed 15,427 kg of the the country's total gold ouput in 1996, while commercial mines yielded the remaining 14,530 kg, he said.

De Vera said he expected the country's gold output to rise further to 43,000 kg by the year 2000 with the opening of the Sibutad gold mine of Philex Mining Corp and the Victoria mine of Lepanto Consolidated Mining Co.
United Paragon Mining Corp is also expanding its mill capacity for its Longos mine in Paracale, Camarines norte in central Philippines.
